text.p: - The Slovenian parliament on Monday refused to elect Janez Podobnik of the conservative People's Party as parliamentary president, although he was the only candidate for the post. The session is due to continue on Tuesday.
- Slovenia's Clinical Centre on Monday successfully conducted its eighth heart transplant.

- Slovenia spends 227.8 million tolars ($1.6 million) on promoting tourism per year, but needs to spend at least 3.65 times more, Franci Krizan, director of Slovenia's Centre for Promotion of Tourism said on Monday.
- Prices of dairy products in Slovenia rose an average six percent depending on the type of product.
- Some 800 companies had completed their privatisation by the end of November, while some 1,300 other companies are still in the process, Slovenia's Privatisation Agency said on Monday.
- Slovenia's trade deficfit for the first 10 months of this year exceeded $1.15 billion, a $301 milllion increase from the same period a year ago, the Statistical Office reported.
- In October there were 120,722 unemployed in Slovenia, 2.2 percent more than in September and four percent less than in same month in 1995, Slovenia's employment office said.
- Joze Lokar, one of Slovenia's most distinguished psychiatrists died on Monday aged 57.
